decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Hours of UseThe use hereby permitted for takeaway (A5) purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times:10.00 - 23.00hours Monday - Sunday, Public and Bank Holidays

Condition : 4 - Waste and Recycled Materials Storage (Details)The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until detail of the arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 5 - Ventilation Equipment - DetailsThe use shall not commence until a scheme (including detailed drawings and maintenance schedule) for the jointly shared extraction system has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - Ventilation Equipment - Implementation The scheme of ventilation approved under Condition 5 shall be fully implemented before the use is commenced.

Condition : 7 - The access doorway to the premises at 311 Chiswick High Road shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
description: Change of use of ground floor shop from a Beauty Salon to A1(retail) and A5 (Hot food take-away) uses and installation of a new shopfront.
